questions.question: To which group of organic molecules does 'Monosaccharides' belong?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Carbohydrates**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Monosaccharides are the simplest form of sugar and the most basic units (monomers) of carbohydrates**.

 
 
• They are usually colourless, water-soluble, and crystalline solids.
 
• Carbohydrates also consist of long chains of linked sugar molecules.
 
• These long chains often contain hundreds or thousands of monosaccharides that are bound together to form polysaccharides.
 
• Plants store sugar in polysaccharides called starch.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **lipid **is any of various organic compounds that are insoluble in water.

 
 
• These include **fats, waxes, oils, hormones and some components of membranes** and act as energy-storing molecules and chemical messengers.
 
 
 
• **Proteins **are large, complex molecules that play many important roles in the body.
 
 
• They perform most functions in cells and are essential for the structure, function and regulation of body tissues and organs.
 
 
 
• **Nucleic acids **are naturally occurring chemical compounds that serve as the primary information-carrying molecules in cells.
 
 
• They play a particularly important role in directing protein synthesis.
 
• The two main classes of nucleic acids are **deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) and ribonucleic acid (RNA)**.

questions.question: Which state of India has the highest percentage of crop land under irrigation?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__.

__
 
• **Punjab tops the country in terms of land under irrigation**, with 98% of its cropland under irrigation.

 
 
• Then comes Haryana, U.P. and A.P respectively.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Punjab **(the land of five rivers) is one of the most fertile regions on earth.

 
 
• The state of Punjab which has earned the name of "the food basket of the country" and "the granary of India", has been contributing 40 per cent rice and 50 to 70 per cent wheat for the last two decades.
 
• Agriculture in the state of Punjab is highly intensive in terms of land, capital, energy, nutrients, agricultural inputs and water etc.
 
• Firozpur district is the largest producer of wheat and rice in the state.
 
• The largest area is under **wheat **crop.
 
• Other important crops of the state are **rice, cotton, sugarcane, bajra, maize, barley and fruits**.

questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India envisages that a person shall NOT be qualified to be chosen to fill up a seat in the Parliament unless he is a citizen of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 84**__.

__
 
• **Article 84 **(Qualification for membership of Parliament)

 
 
• **A person shall not be qualified to be chosen to fill a seat in Parliament unless he**__

 __
 
• (a) **is a citizen of India, and makes and subscribes before some person authorised in that behalf by the Election Commission an oath or affirmation according to the form set out for the purpose in the Third Schedule**__;
 
• (b) is, in the case of a seat in the Council of States, not less than thirty years of age and, in the case of a seat in the House of the People, not less than twenty five years of age; and
 
• (c) possesses such other qualifications as may be prescribed in that behalf by or under any law made by Parliament.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: Who among the following is the author of the epic story 'Manu Charitra'?

• It is the story of Sarvochisha Manu, who ruled the last cosmic age and who serves as the prototype for the first human being here.
 
• Pedana explores the complex workings of the dramatic displacement, imaginative projections that will be required for the birth and formation of Manu.
 
• The Story of Manu is also a book about kingship and its requirements during the time of Krishnadevaraya, the most powerful of the Vijayanagara rulers, who was a close friend and mentor of the poet.
 
• The Story of Manu, presented in the Telugu script with the first translation in any language, is a true masterpiece of early modern South Indian literature.

questions.question: _______ contains and manages all the programs and applications that a computer or other device is able to run.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Operating system**__.

__
 
• **The operating system contains and manages all the programs and applications that a computer or other device is able to run**__.

 __
 
• Operating System (OS) manages all the software and hardware of the computer.
 
• Most of the time, there are several different computer programs running at the same time, and they all need to access your computer's central processing unit (CPU), memory, and storage.
 
• The operating system coordinates all of this to ensure that each program gets what it needs.
 
• **Some examples** of operating systems include **Apple macOS, Microsoft Windows, Google's Android OS, Linux Operating System, and Apple iOS**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Computer hardware** is the physical component that a computer system needs to function.

 
 
• This includes everything with a circuit board that operates within a **PC or laptop; Including motherboard, graphics card, CPU (central processing unit), ventilation fans, webcam, power supply, etc**.
 
 
 
• **The software **includes the complete set of programs, procedures and routines associated with the operation of a computer system.
 
 
• The term was coined to distinguish these instructions from the hardware - that is, the physical components of a computer system.
 
 
 
• **Data science** is an interdisciplinary field that uses scientific methods, procedures, algorithms and systems to extract knowledge and insights from noisy, structured and unstructured data, and applies knowledge and actionable insights from data across a wide range of application domains.

questions.question: Which fibre among the following is used to make rayon clothing?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Cellulose**__.

__
 
• **​Rayon is a man-made fiber prepared by chemical treatment from a natural raw material called cellulose**__.

 __
 
• The cellulose needed to make rayon is obtained from wood pulp. Rayon is obtained by chemical treatment of wood pulp.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pectin **is a fiber found in fruits.

 
 
• It is often used as a thickener in cooking and baking.
 
• It is also sometimes used to make medicine.
 
• People use pectin for **high cholesterol, high triglycerides, heartburn**, and many other conditions, but there is no good scientific evidence to support these uses.
 
 
 
• **Mucilage **is a thick, sticky substance produced by almost all plants and some microorganisms.
 
 
• These microorganisms include protists which use it for their movement.
 
• The direction of their movement is always opposite to that of the mucous secretion.
 
• It is a polar glycoprotein and an exopolysaccharide. In plants, mucilage plays a role in water and food storage, seed germination and membrane thickening.
 
• **Cacti **(and other succulents) and flaxseeds are especially rich sources of mucilage.
 
 
 
• **Gum **base is made of polymers, plasticizers, and resins. Polymers, including elastomers, are responsible for the stretchy and sticky nature of chewing gum.

questions.question: As on 9 December 2020, how many states of India have implemented 'one nation one ration card system'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**9**__.

__
 
• **As of 9th December 2020, nine states have successfully completed reforms in the Public Distribution System (PDS) and implemented the 'One Nation One Ration Card System**__', under which a beneficiary will be able to buy subsidised foodgrains from any Fair Price Shops (FPS) across the country.

 __
 
• The states which have implemented the 'One Nation One Ration Card System' are Andhra Pradesh, Goa, Gujarat Haryana, Karnataka, Kerala, Telangana, Tripura and Uttar Pradesh.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **One Nation One Ration Card:**

 
 
• The ONORC scheme is being implemented by the department for the nationwide portability of ration cards under the National Food Security Act (NFSA).
 
• Through this, all eligible ration card holders/beneficiaries covered under NFSA can get their eligibility from anywhere in the country.
 
• **Benefits**
 
 
• The system allows all NFSA beneficiaries, especially migrant beneficiaries, to claim full or partial food grains from any Fair Price Shop (FPS) in the country through existing ration cards with biometric/Aadhaar authentication.
 
• This system allows their family members back home, if any, to claim the remaining food grains on the same ration card.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The One Nation One Ration Card facility was started as inter-State portability of ration cards in 4 States w.e.f. August 2019.
 
 
• **As of February 2022, 35 states/UTs have implemented the scheme**.

questions.question: A ______ helps serve as a set of rules and principles that all persons in a country can agree upon as the basis of the way in which they want the country to be governed.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**constitution**__.

__
 
• **A constitution aid serves as a set of rules and principles on which all the individuals of a country can agree, the way they want the country to be governed**__. 

 __
 
• This includes not only the type of government, but also an agreement on certain ideals, which they all believe the country should uphold.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• A **democratic **country needs a constitution, because the constitution serves many purposes.

 
 
• First, it sets out certain ideals that form the basis of the country we aspire to or live in as a citizen.
 
• Or, put another way, a constitution tells us what is the fundamental nature of our society. A country is usually made up of different communities of people who share certain beliefs, but do not necessarily agree on all issues.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Preamble **to the Constitution of India lays down the principles of the Constitution and indicates the sources of its authority.

 
 
• It was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 26 November 1949 and celebrated as Republic Day in India on 26 January 1950.
 
 
 
• The **constitution was drafted by the Constituent Assembly**, which was elected by the elected members of the provincial legislatures.
 
 
• The 389-member assembly (reduced to 299 after the Partition of India) took nearly three years to draft the constitution, with eleven sessions spanning a period of 165 days.

questions.question: The minimum paid up equity capital to set up a small finance bank should be of _______, as proposed by RBI as of May 2020.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**200 crores**__.

__
 
• **The minimum paid-up equity capital to set up a small finance bank should be 200 crores, as proposed by RBI as of May 2020**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks (UCBs)**, which are desirous of voluntarily converting into small finance banks, may refer to the Scheme on the voluntary transition of Urban Co-operative Bank into a Small Finance Bank.

 
 
• UCBs applying for transiting to small finance banks or obtaining in-principle approval for such transition (under the above-referred scheme), will be required to ensure compliance with these ‘on tap’ licensing guidelines from the date of commencement of business as small finance bank except the guideline on minimum capital.
 
• The minimum net worth of such small finance banks shall be Rs.100 crore from the date of commencement of business.
 
• **However, they will have to increase their minimum net worth to Rs.200 crore within five years from the date of commencement of business**__.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Small Finance Banks** are one of the niche banks in India.

 
 
• Banks with a small finance bank license can provide basic banking services for the acceptance of deposits and loans.
 
• The objective behind these is to provide financial inclusion to those sections of the economy which are not being served by other banks, such as small business units, small and marginal farmers, micro and small scale industries and institutions in the unorganized sector.

questions.question: Who among the following begun his excavations at Dholavira in 1990?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**RS Bisht**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

__
 
• The ancient site at Dholavira was first discovered by Jagat Pati Joshi in 1966-68, and excavated almost two decades later by a team led by R.S. Bisht in the 1990s.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dholavira **was discovered in 1968 by the archaeologist Jagatpati Joshi.

 
 
• ** Excavations of the site between 1990 and 2005 under the supervision of archaeologist R S Bisht** revealed the ancient city, which was a commercial and manufacturing centre for about 1,500 years before its collapse and eventual ruin in 1500 BC.
 
• Dholavira is one of the two most notable excavations of the Indus Valley Civilization or Harappan culture, dating back to 4500 years ago.
 
• While the second site, Lothal, is more elaborately educated and easier to access, a visit to Lothal only complements rather than replaces a visit to Dholavira.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__

__
 
• **UNESCO has included Dholavira of Kutch in the list of World Heritage Sites in 2021**.
